evidence.finding: Fresh 2026 IRVE-derived records still identify Green Technologie stations in Martinique/Guadeloupe; Rivière-Pilote is current and paid.
Multiple current third-party IRVE mirrors expose 0.40 EUR/kWh for Green Technologie stations, including Rivière-Pilote, but these are not accepted as CPO-direct tariff authority.

Green Technologie is confirmed as an EV charging/energy operator, but no current first-party network tariff page, deterministic public/guest station resolver, QR/ad-hoc tariff endpoint or official bulk price grid was recovered.
A historical Bellefontaine project was explicitly free; this proves station-specific tariff variation and forbids extrapolating a single network-wide 0.40 EUR/kWh tariff.

decision: active->setAside. Preserve current estate identity, but do not promote third-party 0.40 EUR/kWh observations to CPO-direct authority and do not extrapolate across Caribbean stations.
tariffPolicy: Exact first-party/producer/QR/guest tariff per station/EVSE required. Electra then Electroverse only as roaming fallback.
